notes: Templatic/clitic-heavy course: the vast majority of flags are Arabic clitics and inflected verb stems (ل، بـ، ي، ها، ه، في، من، أن، كان) glossed contextually as role='component' inside larger LEGOs (52 fp_subgloss), or English target morphology of one lemma — infinitive 'to'-marker, subject prefix, copula, article a/an, tense (60 fp_inflection). Only 5 are learner-facing real issues: 4 drilled USE/BUILD sentences where one Arabic word (speak/talk, find out/know) got two English answers (consolidate), plus one genuine mistranslation (صحيحاً 'true' glossed 'the same thing'); none high-frequency enough to block release.

real_fixes.known: أي من أصدقائك أردت أن تتحدث معه الليلة الماضية؟
targets: which of your friends did you want to speak to last night?
which of your friends did you want to talk to last night?
real_fixes.canonical_english: which of your friends did you want to talk to last night?
real_fixes.action: تتحدث glossed as both 'speak to' and 'talk to' on the SAME drilled USE sentence; pick one (talk to) and re-gloss the duplicate to match.

real_fixes.known: لا أريد أن أتوقف عن الكلام بالإنجليزية
targets: I don't want to stop talking in English
I don't want to stop speaking in English
real_fixes.canonical_english: I don't want to stop talking in English
real_fixes.action: الكلام glossed as both 'talking' and 'speaking' on the same drilled USE sentence; choose one (talking) and re-gloss the other to match the course's الكلام→'talking' convention.
أعرف drilled (BUILD) as both 'find out' and 'know' for the identical prompt أريد أن أعرف; pick one register (find out) and re-gloss the other so the learner gets one consistent answer.

real_fixes.known: لم نكن نأمل في الاستيقاظ بهذه السرعة
targets: we didn't hope to wake that quickly
we didn't hope to wake so quickly
real_fixes.canonical_english: we didn't hope to wake so quickly
real_fixes.action: بهذه السرعة glossed 'that quickly' vs 'so quickly' on the same drilled sentence (USE/BUILD); pick one (so quickly).

real_fixes.known: لكنني لست متأكداً إذا كان ذلك صحيحاً
targets: but I'm not sure if it's the same thing
but I'm not sure if it's true
real_fixes.canonical_english: but I'm not sure if it's true
real_fixes.action: ذلك صحيحاً means 'that is true/correct'; the gloss 'the same thing' (نفس الشيء) is a mistranslation. Correct that single BUILD row to 'true'.
